On Wed, Oct 5, 2022 at 3:57 PM Johnny Walsh <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi! Very happy to chat about this; I was gratified to see such interest in mis/disinfo at the ACVFA meeting too.
I'm adding Sofie who can help us set something up, but in general, I have windows basically any day next
week.
I'm not sure about briefing on the Info Resilience Council specifically - we're under instructions to keep that
extremely non-public (due to a PR disaster that DHS experienced over a similar body), but ACVFA is kind of a
gray area. Either way, we are enthusiastic to talk about the issue itself, and USAID's potential response to it.
On Wed, Oct 5, 2022 at 3:21 PM Sophia Lajaunie <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Shannon, Johnny, and all,
Thanks very much for joining our first ACVFA meeting on Friday. Lots of interesting ideas shared, and looking
forward to hopefully channeling that energy into some impactful outcomes.
As you saw there was clearly a lot of interest on the issue of dis/misinformation. This will likely be a main issue
the committee works on (likely a smaller subgroup of members would focus on it), and I'd love to set some
time to hear your thoughts on this as well as your reactions to the meeting in general. I am also
restructuring our workplan proposal based on Friday's convo.
I am also adding +Vera Zakem here following the Administrator's note in a recent DWW (attached) regarding a
potential presentation on the Information Resilience Council at the next ACVFA meeting. Would love to discuss
this and the IRC in general, potential opportunities for collaboration/support, etc.
Let me know which days might work best this week or next and happy to send a calendar invite. Please also of
course add anyone else who should join. Also including +Donald Steinberg +Jodi Herman lead advisors for
Thanks all very much!
